title: Lead Engineer
description:
As a Java Application Developer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining high\-quality Java web applications that support business transaction and reporting needs. You will collaborate with team members to determine design specifications, participate in code reviews, and contribute to internal infrastructure and process improvements. Your role will require strong technical competency, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in an environment that values quality, commitment, growth, and innovation. You will also assist with production problem resolution as needed, including occasional off\-hour support.
   

  

**Application \& API Development** 
 :
   

  

* Develop Java web applications and RESTful APIs, performing technical design, code development, documentation, and test plan generation.
* Design and implement solutions following microservices architecture and established design patterns (e.g., Dependency Injection, Repository pattern).
* Maintain a sustained track record of delivering high\-quality solutions on time and within budget.


**Cloud\-Native Development \& DevOps** 
 :
   

  

* Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (primary) and Microsoft Azure.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate build, test, and deployment processes.


**Application Security** 
 :
   

  

* Follow secure coding practices to protect against common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10, including SQL injection, XSS, and CSRF).
* Implement authentication and authorization using industry standards such as OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
* Monitor and remediate security vulnerabilities in application dependencies and third\-party packages.
* Support compliance and data protection requirements applicable to the application.


**Data Management** 
 :
   

  

* Store, retrieve, and manipulate data related to web applications for transactions and reporting.
* Design database schemas and optimize queries for performance and data integrity.


**Testing \& Quality Assurance** 
 :
   

  

* Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests, and participate in code reviews to uphold coding standards.
* Troubleshoot, bug\-fix, and validate application behavior across the development lifecycle.


**Cross\-Functional \& Agile Collaboration** 
 :
   

  

* Collaborate with product owners, designers, and fellow developers in Agile/Scrum teams to determine design specifications and technical details.
* Work together with colleagues on internal infrastructure and process improvements.


**Application Maintenance \& Optimization** 
 :
   

  

* Modify existing applications to correct errors, adapt to new software upgrades, or improve performance.


**Production Support** 
 :
   

  

* Assist in production problem resolution as needed, including occasional off\-hour support.


**Key Competencies:**
**Technical Expertise** 
 :
   

  

* In\-depth working knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, and Hibernate/JPA, with current experience on Java 17/Java 21 (LTS) and Spring Boot 4\.x.
* Modern front\-end proficiency in React (with Next.js) and/or Angular, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive/component\-based UI design; legacy jQuery/JavaScript experience a plus.
* AI\-assisted development skills, including GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini for day\-to\-day coding, and experience building or integrating AI features using Google Vertex AI and Spring AI.
* Cloud development and deployment experience with Google Cloud Platform (primary) — including Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, and Cloud Functions — with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS as a plus.
* Database experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, and MS SQL Server, including schema design, query performance tuning, and data migration.
* Experience developing and automating unit tests using JUnit 5 and/or TestNG, with mocking/assertion libraries such as Mockito and AssertJ.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to support continuous testing and delivery.
* Experience with code management tools (e.g., Git, SVN) and website performance testing.


**Domain and Support Experience** 
 :
   

  

* Automobile domain experience.
* Experience supporting global applications.


**Attention to Detail and Multitasking** 
 :
   

  

* Excellent attention to detail with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly.


**Additional Tools Knowledge (a plus)** 
 :
   

  

* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, Dynatrace, Postman, SonarQube, and JMeter.


**Technology Application** 
 :
   

  

* Apply strong web development experience in Java Technologies to build and support mid\- to high\-scale internet web sites.


**Quality Assurance** 
 :
   

  

* Perform website performance testing and ensure solutions meet quality, performance, and reliability standards.


**Certifications and Continued Growth (Desired but not required)** 
 :
   

  

* Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE Developer.
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer certification.
* Knowledge of other programming languages.
* Knowledge of Content Management Systems.
* Mobile application development.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are seeking a
 ****Senior Staff Engineer (L6\)****
 to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
   

  

 This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI\-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
   

  

 You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote\-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US\-based engineering and product partners.
   

  

 Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self\-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single\-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross\-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands\-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non\-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI\-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI\-assisted engineering: spec\-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross\-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions


**What Will Help You Succeed**
 The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
   

  

****Must\-haves****
* 10–12\+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi\-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node
* Strong distributed systems and event\-driven architecture experience — queues, streams, idempotency, eventual consistency, and backpressure
* Hands\-on AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis or equivalent) and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
* Solid relational data modeling and query tuning (MySQL, Postgres), plus search or analytical stores (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Snowflake)
* Demonstrated ability to review other people’s designs and improve them. You can point to architectures that are better because you were in the room
* Practical, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and of spec\-driven development, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* Credibility without authority: able to influence squads you are not part of, and to mentor senior engineers without managing them
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort operating across India and US time zones
* Comfort with ambiguity and rotation — the willingness to be reassigned to the highest\-value problem rather than owning one fixed surface


****Nice to have****
* Utility, energy, or fintech data domain experience
* Web data acquisition at scale (Puppeteer, headless Chrome, anti\-bot mitigation)
* Document extraction, OCR, or LLM\-based extraction pipelines
* dbt and analytics engineering on Snowflake
* Experience modernizing legacy monoliths into services while keeping delivery running


****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****
 Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. While we are currently unable to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates eligible to work in India.

* Bring experience in hybrid work environments and be comfortable collaborating across distributed teams using remote and onsite engagement models while maintaining effective communication.
* Leverage retail banking domain exposure when available to better understand account transactions risk indicators and regulatory needs enabling data solutions that support responsible financial services.

 Preferred certifications include Azure Data Engineer Associate or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or equivalent modern data architecture credential.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First

 Full\-Time

 November 2026 onward, with staggered start dates
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Mid\-Level to Senior
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 The engineering organization is scaling rapidly in India, with multiple Backend Engineer openings across several product workstreams.
   

  

 Depending on your experience and interests, you may join one of the following areas:
   

  

* Agentic Security: Real\-time policy enforcement for AI agent actions, tool calls, and data access.
* AI Security Gateway: High\-performance proxy between enterprise applications and LLM providers, covering inline inspection, DLP, rate limiting, and streaming.
* Platform: Shared multi\-tenant foundations including identity/RBAC, configuration, event streaming, storage, and internal APIs.
* Data Security Integration: Event\-driven integrations between AI security products and existing data security infrastructure.
* Cloud Discovery: Services that discover AI agents, model endpoints, and AI\-enabled applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and map their access.
* Agentic AI Forensics: Ingestion, indexing, and querying of agent traces and security events for investigation and analysis.
* AI Risk Research: Tooling and testing harnesses that enable security researchers to identify and validate attacks against AI agents.


 Across all workstreams, the core stack includes
 **Go, Python, gRPC/REST, event streaming, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms** 
 . AI\-assisted development is also a core part of the engineering workflow.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, build, and operate production Go services with high standards for performance, reliability, and multi\-tenancy.
* Design APIs and data models, owning service contracts, idempotency, retries, and back\-pressure.
* Build event\-driven pipelines and integrations with cloud providers, internal systems, or AI/agent frameworks.
* Own service reliability through testing, observability, CI/CD, and production readiness.
* Use Python for tooling, testing, migrations, automation, or data workflows.
* Collaborate with AI engineers, security researchers, and product teams on threat models and enforcement logic.
* Use AI coding assistants as part of your daily development, testing, and debugging workflow.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, including 2\+ years building production services in Go. Senior roles require 6\+ years overall and 3\+ years in Go.
* Strong understanding of Go concurrency, networking, and performance, including goroutines, channels, context, and profiling.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience designing gRPC and REST APIs, working with protobuf, and building asynchronous/event\-driven systems such as Kafka or equivalent.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases in distributed systems.
* Strong testing discipline and attention to data correctness.
* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must\-have.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote\-first, distributed environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with API gateways, proxies, policy/authorization engines such as OPA or Cedar, or service meshes.
* Deep knowledge of a major cloud provider's APIs and IAM model.
* Experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, ClickHouse, or other search/indexing and columnar data systems at scale.
* Familiarity with LLM agent frameworks, tool\-calling protocols, and AI/agent security.
* Experience building multi\-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Background in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust \& safety.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.


 AI\-First Engineering
   

  

 AI is a core part of how this team builds software.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real\-world engineering: the tools you rely on, how you validate their output, and how AI has changed your development workflow.
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem\-solving** 
 , not simply as an autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Build a greenfield product at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Work on Go services operating at enterprise scale and protecting some of the world's largest organizations.
* Take ownership of a product workstream and influence architecture from an early stage.
* Work alongside a highly technical, distributed engineering team where AI is a core part of the development process.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 The Endpoint Security team extends these controls directly to user devices, detecting AI tools and agents running on laptops and workstations, monitoring their access to local data, and enforcing security policies where traffic never reaches a gateway.
   

  

 You'll build the
 **Go\-based endpoint components and backend services**

 What You'll Do

* Build backend services for endpoint fleet management, including configuration, policy distribution, telemetry ingestion, and health monitoring.

* 5\+ years of backend or systems development experience, including 3\+ years building production software in Go.
* Hands\-on experience with OS\-level programming, including processes, file systems, networking stacks, and system APIs on at least two of Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Working knowledge of Python for tooling and testing.
* Experience with gRPC/REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Familiarity with eBPF, ETW, Apple's Endpoint Security framework, or other kernel\-adjacent technologies.

 AI\-First Engineering

 This role is accountable for assisting with for detailed design for certain modules/sub\-systems, doing prototype for multi\-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients.

description:

 **Senior DevSecOps Engineer**

With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow, responsible for architecting and maintaining the high\-security infrastructure required for an enterprise\-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP). You will be tasked with building the secure "sandbox" where autonomous agents live, ensuring zero\-trust connectivity and managing the specialized data stores that power agentic reasoning.
   

  

 You will lead the setup of the AWS production environment and the implementation of Firecracker MicroVMs to provide isolated, ephemeral runtimes for agents. You are the guardian of the platform's "Egress Controls," ensuring that while agents can reason over proprietary data, they can never exfiltrate it.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Agent Sandboxing \& Isolation: Implement and manage Firecracker MicroVMs (or restricted Kubernetes/Docker environments) to ensure agents execute in strictly isolated, secure runtimes
* Secure Data Infrastructure: Provision and optimize the platform's multi\-layered data stack, including PostgreSQL (OLTP), ChromaDB/PGVector (VectorStore), and GraphDB (Neo4j) for relational knowledge mapping
* Event Orchestration: Build and manage high\-performance Event Streams (AWS SQS, Event Bridge, or Kafka) to handle agent\-to\-agent communication and Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) escalation triggers
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate the provisioning of AWS cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters using industry\-standard tools
* Security \& Identity Integration: Implement WorkOS/IDP for B2B identity management and multi\-tenancy, ensuring strict logical separation of tenant data and configurations
* Network Hardening: Design and enforce strict egress firewalls and proxy\-only outbound routing to prevent data exfiltration by autonomous agents


**Requirements**
* Cloud \& Containers: Deep expertise in AWS, Kubernetes, and container security; proven experience with Firecracker MicroVMs is highly desirable
* Database Management: Hands\-on experience managing and scaling Vector Databases (Chroma, PGVector) and Graph Databases for AI applications
* Security First Mindset: Strong understanding of zero\-trust architecture, OWASP principles, and secure design for AI systems
* Messaging \& Events: Proficiency in managing event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms for real\-time data processing
* Automation: Advanced scripting skills (Python, Bash) and a track record of implementing automated security gates in CI/CD pipelines

**Desirable**

* Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with LangSmith or Langfuse for observability and tracing of agent workloads


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations

 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

 The unit manages and modernizes enterprise data and analytics platforms including SAP BW, SAP Business Objects, Azure\-based data platforms, and reporting solutions while supporting strategic initiatives related to data modernization, cloud adoption, operational reporting, compliance, and financial transparency.
   

  

**Duties And Accountabilities**
**Role Purpose**
 The Platform Engineer (SAP BW \& Data Platform) is responsible for the engineering, administration, modernization, and operational excellence of the World Bank Group's enterprise analytics and data platforms.
   

  

 The role supports SAP BW on HANA, Business Objects, SAP data integration technologies, Azure\-based data platforms, and enterprise reporting solutions. The Platform Engineer collaborates with product owners, architects, data engineers, business stakeholders, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform reliability, performance, scalability, security, governance, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 The position contributes to the evolution of enterprise analytics capabilities through automation, modernization initiatives, cloud adoption, DevOps practices, observability, and platform engineering principles, enabling trusted and timely business insights across financial and operational domains.

**SAP BW Platform Engineering**
* Administer, maintain, and optimize SAP BW on HANA environments.

* Support business\-critical financial and operational reporting processes.
* Ensure platform availability, resiliency, scalability, and operational stability.

* Perform professional\-level analysis and platform engineering activities across data and analytics platforms.
* Solve moderately complex platforms, integration, performance, and operational challenges.

* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the platform engineering and analytics delivery teams.

**Integration \& Data Operations**
* Manage SAP BW, SAP ECC, SAP BODS, and related enterprise data integrations.
* Support incident response, root cause analysis, and issue remediation activities.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to ensure reliable data movement and processing.
* Monitor platform health, data loads, and integration performance.


**Analytics \& Reporting Platforms**
* Support Business Objects, Power BI, Bex, Analysis for Office and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Ensure reporting platform performance, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Partner with business stakeholders to enable trusted, timely, and scalable reporting capabilities.


**Security, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure compliance with World Bank security, audit, data governance, and operational risk requirements.
* Support security reviews, vulnerability remediation, and platform hardening activities.
* Participate in audit response and compliance remediation efforts.
* Maintain appropriate controls for access management, data protection, and system integrity.


**Agile Delivery \& Collaboration**
* Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, Iteration Planning, Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Scrum Masters, and Engineering teams to prioritize platform improvements.
* Contribute to backlog refinement and technical roadmap planning.
* Support continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.


 Selection Criteria
   

  

**Education \& Experience**
* Master's degree with 5 years of relevant experience or Bachelor's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW, data engineering, analytics platforms, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale analytics, reporting, and data platforms.
* Experience with SAP BW on HANA administration, development support, and platform operations.
* Experience with enterprise data integration, analytics modernization, and cloud data platform technologies.


**Core Skills And Capabilities**
 Strong expertise in SAP BW on HANA, SAP BODS, data platform engineering, data warehousing, analytics, integration, and enterprise reporting, complemented by hands\-on experience with Azure Databricks and cloud\-based data platforms. Skilled in platform operations, DevOps, database management, security, governance, monitoring, and modern data architecture practices to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure enterprise analytics solutions.
   

  

 Advanced analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and Agile delivery skills, with the ability to effectively manage stakeholders, influence decisions, and foster collaboration across cross\-functional teams to achieve business and technology objectives.

 SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), SAP BW, Databricks Data Engineer Certification, TOGAF Certification

title: Associate Technical Lead, HPC Software
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non\-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**

 Minimum 5 to 12 years of experience in Software Development \- Strong academics in BE / B Tech / MTech / MCA / MS (CS/IT)

* Diverse Experience in OO analysis, design, development and unit testing
* Good in programming fundamentals, C\+\+, STL and Boost Library
* Hands\-on experience in measuring and optimizing (e.g. via assembly coding, vectorization, SSE or Intel IPP) application performance. Addressing issues that may arise due to I/O, network performance and memory mgmt
* Linux Shell scripting
* Strong Operating System fundamentals \- LINUX OS/Kernel Internals
* Knowledge of Socket programming, distributing processing and MPI (message passing interface)
* Good understanding of Parallel Computing concepts using multi\-core and GPU.

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Doctorate (Academic) , Master's Level Degree or work experience of 2 years , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 3 years

You will contribute to the design, development, integration, and maintenance of Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) firmware for hyperscale server platforms.
   

  

 You will work closely with platform firmware, hardware, validation, and customer engineering teams to develop platform management capabilities, enable new server platforms, troubleshoot complex system issues, and enhance the reliability and security of large\-scale datacenter deployments.
   

  

 This is a highly technical role where your contributions directly impact server manageability, firmware quality, platform security, and customer success.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design, develop, and maintain BMC firmware features for hyperscale server platforms.
* Debugging and bug fixing of issues reported by customers.
* Develop an understanding of internal/customer workflow and integrate that understanding in all aspects of design and development.
* Working with stakeholders on technical issues including software system design and maintenance.
* Perform unit testing of implementation and Create, Update, and maintain project specific documentation.
* Provide timely technical risk assessments, schedule estimates, and status reports.
* Manage complex tasks across competing projects and schedules.
* Driving firmware quality, performance optimization, and platform reliability improvements
* Document firmware architecture, design decisions, debug methodologies, and customer solutions
* Stay current with emerging firmware technologies, new industry standards and specifications


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline
* 2\+ years of BMC development experience
* Strong programming skills in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience in BMC development
* Hands on experience with OpenBMC services such as GPIO monitoring, Entity Manager, IPMI, bmcweb (Redfish)
* Knowledge on OpenBMC automation framework for unit testing
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Self\-starter capable of driving solutions independently and delivering results in a fast\-paced environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline
* 2\+ years of BMC Development experience
* Knowledge on Kernel/driver level development \& debugging
* Knowledge on Robot framework, Shell scripting
* Good zest for learning and adapting to changing requirements
* Experience working directly with OEMs, ODMs, silicon vendors, or hyperscale customers


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a maintenance or integration\-only role.
   

  

 You'll be working on the core firmware that enables platform management, monitoring, telemetry, and remote operations for hyperscale datacenter servers deployed at scale across cloud environments.
   

  

**LOCATION**
 Chennai , India
   

  

 Full\-Time

 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 India
